window: UTC calendar month unless a rolling window is stated

availability.denominator: authenticated non-health requests received by every instance
availability.source_of_truth: slo_successful_requests_total and slo_eligible_requests_total unioned by request_id
availability.privacy_rule: no org, actor, email, token, IP, or raw request data

acknowledged_event_loss.source_of_truth: raw event ledger joined to acknowledgement and audit records
acknowledged_event_loss.window: UTC calendar month and per incident
acknowledged_event_loss.retention: 13 months counters plus immutable ledger policy
acknowledged_event_loss.privacy_rule: payloads and identifiers stay out of telemetry

ingest_rate.denominator: elapsed UTC seconds with an active ingest window
ingest_rate.source_of_truth: worker processed event counter and broker receipt timestamps
ingest_rate.window: 5 minute rolling window and 1 hour report
ingest_rate.privacy_rule: no source, device, tenant, location, or payload labels

api_read_latency.denominator: all GET requests including failures, excluding health and metrics
api_read_latency.privacy_rule: route templates only; no query string or body

dashboard_latency.denominator: authenticated dashboard read requests including failures
dashboard_latency.privacy_rule: no user, incident, coordinate, or response-body labels

saturation.denominator: declared CPU, memory, database connection, and worker capacity
saturation.source_of_truth: process and database pool gauges plus worker capacity

queue_age.denominator: messages present in each durable queue
queue_age.source_of_truth: broker enqueue and worker receipt timestamps
queue_age.privacy_rule: message ids, keys, tenant ids, and payloads are never labels

dependency_health.denominator: dependencies with a declared endpoint and executed probe
dependency_health.source_of_truth: dependency_health gauge and deep health result
dependency_health.threshold: all required dependencies reachable; unknown is not healthy
dependency_health.privacy_rule: no endpoint URLs, credentials, connection strings, or exception bodies
